shots.description: A world in the edge. Sunlight and reflections at the glass entrance.
The moving mirror. Clouds and the white facade shift in reflection.
Reflection becomes a place. The open glass entrance and sunlit lobby.
The invisible corner. Reflections resolve into a clear conference room.
Reveal the building. The completed facade in clear afternoon light.
